profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer I at LexisNexis
profile.summary: Seasoned Software Engineer with expertise in C# and .NET. Passionate for learning, and always eager to explore new technologies and opportunities. With 5 years of experience in software development, I offer a robust skill set (ADO, AWS, .NET 7.0, SQL, Rest APIs, Angular 14) and agile mindset.

positions.title: Software developer
positions.description:
•	Developed chat feature for clients to message users in real time using SignalR in ASP.NET Webform legacy application
•	Implemented PSPDFKit PDF markup tool for both mobile and web applications using a vendor-provided docker container
•	Architected and built new web application using .NET Core, Entity Framework, bootstrap and Telerik tools for vendors in a small development team of 4
•	Supported new iOS application by fixing any bugs found by users
•	Created new RFP process from RFP creation to vendor awarding including DB schema, stored procedures and UI for both vendor web application and our legacy client web application
•	Enhanced interface for archived documents search application and implemented index-searching in DB and hit highlighting in UI

positions.title: Project Manager / Business Analyst
positions.description:
• Led cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time and within budget to the business
• Produced meeting minutes, project workplan and deliverable for all projects to maintain project team and stakeholders informed throughout project life cycle
• Provided status reports on a bi-weekly basis for executive team during project board meetings
• Worked with business users to develop requirements for new and improved reporting capabilities on external agent web portal
• Coordinated process for determining future state for homegrown policy admin system, including developing RFP to send to 5 external vendors, holding onsite Show and Tell sessions and presenting ultimate recommendation to executive team

positions.title: Designated Hitter/Photo Technician
positions.description:
•	Assisted the store to exceed its monthly sales goals in 8 of 14 months
•	Work collaboratively in a team of 12 to create an inviting service-oriented store for customers and employees.
•	Achieved 100 percent customer satisfaction on surveys.
•	Collaborated with store team to manage store inventory and order stock.

volunteerExperiences.description: For about 3 months, I collaborated with 5 other student volunteers to organize a field day for special needs children. In order to get the day organized, we communicated with school staff to plan a day full of activities that lasted 1-2 hours. Collected T-shirts to share with the children after the event as a reward for activities. Contacted ECU's College of Business to gather 25 small bags with various items, including 25 extra T-shirts.
Worked with children to teach how to basic code using Python language, in a Raspberry Pi computer.

organizations.name: Association of Information Technology Professionals (AITP)
organizations.description: I’m the current co-president of the Association of Information Technology Professionals (AITP);  I take pride in my work within AITP since it is a national organization that has many members across the entire United States. Its dedication to education and promoting networking within the organization, has helped me learn how to communicate more efficiently in a business environment, and also provided me with interesting knowledge about the industry. During my involvement in AITP, I managed to grab the attention of more members, while helping organize informational, networking trips, such as our trip to CISCO last year with 30+ members attending.
